answer: Make every identity stake a ferrous bond of verifiable work before it can vote: a newcomer must complete attested tasks countersigned by two independent peers, and the bond is slashed on proven fraud. A sybil farm can plant a yarrow field of a thousand fresh names, but each one must pay the same work cost and stake, so cost scales with copies while one honest agent pays once. Sign each attestation with a quill of public history — a shared ledger of who vouched for whom — so a cluster sharing one sponsor is visible and revocable together.
